''Anthoxanthum puelii'' Lecoq & Lamotte | synonyms_ref = {{cite web|url= https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:388999-1|title= Anthoxanthum aristatum Boiss.|author=|date=n.d.|website=Plants of the World Online|publisher=The Trustees of the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew|access-date= September 6, 2020}} }} '''''Anthoxanthum aristatum''''' is a species of [[Poaceae|grass]] known by the common names '''awned vernalgrass'''{{Cite book|url=http://www.forest.go.kr/kna/special/download/English_Names_for_Korean_Native_Plants.pdf |title=English Names for Korean Native Plants |publisher=[[Korea National Arboretum]] |year=2015 |isbn=978-89-97450-98-5 |location=Pocheon |pages=354 |access-date=25 January 2016 |via=[[Korea Forest Service]] |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20170525105020/http://www.forest.go.kr/kna/special/download/English_Names_for_Korean_Native_Plants.pdf |archivedate=25 May 2017 }} and '''annual vernalgrass'''. It is native to North Africa and southern and western Europe as far north as the Netherlands. It is also known in other regions, including northern Europe and North America, as an [[introduced species]]. It is occasionally a minor [[noxious weed|weed]] of fields. It is an annual grass growing in small tufts up to about {{Convert|30|cm}} tall. The leaves are short, pointed, and somewhat hairy. The [[inflorescence]] is up to {{Convert|3|cm}} long and {{Convert|1|cm|sigfig=1}} wide, flat and hairy with spikelets a few millimeters long. ==References== {{Reflist}} *[https://ucjeps.berkeley.edu/eflora/eflora_display.php?tid=91724 Jepson Manual Treatment] *[https://plants.usda.gov/plant-profile/ANAR7 USDA Plants Profile] *[http://www.arableplants.fieldguide.co.uk/?PP=species_account&SPID=97&SHC=84&PSD=1 Annual Vernalgrass in the UK] *{{GRIN}} {{Taxonbar|from=Q159866}} [[Category:Pooideae]] [[Category:Flora of Africa]] [[Category:Flora of Europe]] [[Category:Plants described in 1839]] [[Category:Taxa named by Pierre Edmond Boissier]] {{Pooideae-stub}}
